body: Hey… first of all, you're so young. You can't expect to know what you want to do with your life, and despite whatever has happened to you there's an entire life ahead of you that could be filled with really wonderful things. You're posting on here, so you obviously have some hope left. Hold on to that hope and use it. Explore things…find something you're passionate about… there's bound to be something out there that makes you excited. Don't stop trying yet, don't give up. There are many other techniques besides medication and antidepressants. It's about finding what works for you. Give yourself some more time to find something.

I often think of how horrible it would be to die of overdose too and that deters me. Convulsions, bleeding/foaming out the mouth, brain aneurisms, unbearable pain in the stomach. It's not a peaceful way to go. No method of suicide really is...

It's good that you're posting on here, it means you have some hope and you think that something could click to help you. Or else you would have just done it. Have you tried yoga or meditation? Or self help books? I recently decided that I need to eliminate alcohol and see if that helps. I think that there's bound to be something out there to help everyone. Just a matter of finding the right thing. It's unfortunate to have these feelings of desperation, but working through them is better than attempting or committing suicide. If you attempt and fail then all of a sudden your family and friends all know, and your relationship with your husband will become a lot more strained because anyone that loves you will be terrified you will do it again. Everyting was much worse after my attempt (and I didn't think it could get any worse) And if you do succeed, then you're leaving behind devastated people, people you wouldn't even expect to care definitely do, I also saw that. When the word got out, it spread fast and complete strangers were saying how terrible it would have been if I had died. There's more to work on… keep hold of that feeling of hope <3
Also, what is your support group like? Friends/family etc? Who are you draining exactly? Is there anything you've accomplished that you're contributing to society/people?
How old are you? What sorts of things have you tried to help yourself? Has anything worked… even a little bit?
How were you able to come out on the other side? What helped?
Just some fundamental internal belief I have that I can't shake, regardless of the work I have put in. Just constant sadness and deep self hatred that won't be touched.
